A google plus game I was in yesterday had an interesting result.

 

We were facing the Matriarch, and in the last turn before she was defeated she played a darken the skies bringing back all her dead birds. The Naturalist finished off the Matriarch and destroyed the mask freeing all the birds from her control without killing them. We all agreed this was a pretty perfect victory for the Naturalist. He got to save the world and defend the helpless animals forced into the conflict.

 

Does anyone else have stories like this? I don't mean the obvious hero got the final blow on their nemesis.

posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
I had one awesome fight, with Haka, ExPat, Ra, and someone else (I don't remember exactly, but their incap let them destroy environment cards, I think; this was before Infernal Relics, I think) VS. Plague Rat in Insula Primalis. At a certain point in the game, Plague Rat was still at 65 HP, Haka was down to 1, and everyone else was incapped. I still won.

As it turns out, Mere + 3 dominions + 2 extra powers per round + a free environment destruction each round is a pretty good way to build up your hand size. It turned into what I imagined to be a down-to-the-wire, no-holds-barred beatdown between Haka and Plague Rat. No one else there (conscious, anyway), nothing getting in the way; just an extremely pissed off Maori in Barbarian Rage mode and a giant rat man beating the crap out of each other. Each round it went something like:

Plage rat plays a card, deals damage. Deals a little more damage at end of turn.

Ra's turn: Haka punches Plague Rat. Draw a card.

Expat's turn: Haka punches Plague Rat. Draw a card.

???'s turn: destroy an environment card. Draw 3 cards.

Haka's turn: play elbow smash, rampage, or Haka of Restoration; punch Plague Rat; draw a card. draw a card.

Environment happens. Not very relevant.

Repeat.

 

It was an awesome turnaround, and still one of my favorite victories.

 

Oh, and then there was one game where Dawn played "Channel The Eclipse" with her damage buffed by 3. While she had 5 HP.

"Will my powers kill me? Certainly. But they will surely kill YOU fir-" DED.

posts.cooked: The other day three of us were playing against Gloomweaver.  Our team was Mr. Fixer, Unity and Fanatic.  But the real awesome was when we picked to fight Gloomweaver in Rook City.  Turn 2 we drew Tony Taurus, and our we rapidly realized that he was instrumental to burying Gloomweaver's relics at the bottom of the deck, thus ensuring our victory.  Tony Taurus won us that game, and Fanatic spent almost the entire game protecting him with her special protection power that hurt her.  It was essentially what happens when a Call of Cthulhu game crosses over with superheroes.  We even began to ship Tony and Fanatic together in a very unresolved sexual tension fashion.  Taurus reliably kept all relics out of play.  And we finished when Fanatic, with ONE HIT POINT, triggered her ability that did as much damage to the enemy as she had damage on her.  So she nuked the evil shadow god back to its realm with the power of her faith.  It was beautiful.

posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked:
Just had a crazy game against Advanced Voss. It was Haka, G.I. Bunker, Visionary, Ra, and Tempest versus Voss. For a second, it looked like the heroes would fail. A Forced Deployment had put over 10 minions into play, and on that turn Voss played another Forced Deployment. Fortunatley, Tempest had an Into the Stratosphere in his hand. Even with Panzer Buster, I wasn't quite able to kill Voss in that first round with 39 HP, and so Haka Ground Pounded instead. Bunker killed the minions in play with an External Combustion so that Voss wouldn't win at the start of his turn, and also did Panzer Buster. My plan was to ignore the army and go straight for Voss, but I ended up doing so much more. Visionary had taken heavy damage, and had been in a cocoon for most of the game. Ra and Tempest did damage to Voss.

At the start of the next villain round, Forced Deployment brought out all the minions Bunker had killed. At the end of the villain turn, Voss had 13 minions and Vyktor in play. Haka used a Haka of Battle and a Taiaha to smack Voss and whittle down the Guard. Bunker finished off the guard with Gattling Gun, went into Turret Mode and hit Voss with the Omni-Cannon. Visionary had demoralize and hit almost everything for 1. That's when I realized I could do it. I could kill Voss, and all the minions. By the time it was Ra's turn, Voss was down to four HP,and so Ra weakened the Psi-worms that Visionary couldn't damage. On Tempest's turn, Tempest murdered everyone with Electrical storm, a Chain Lightning, and Grievous Hailstorm. Voss was utterly defeated and peace was restored to the Multiverse.
